description_en: Modifies the proxy performance level of a specified PolarDB cluster and supports scheduled execution
description_zh: 调整指定 PolarDB 集群的代理性能级别，支持通过计划时间安排执行
name: RefreshProxyLevel

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PolarDB cluster
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The earliest time to start the proxy specification upgrade, in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 计划开始执行代理规格升级的最早时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ（UTC）
parameters.name: planned_start_time

parameters.help_en: The latest time to start the proxy specification upgrade, in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 计划开始执行代理规格升级的最晚时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ（UTC）
parameters.name: planned_end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the execution is initiated by the scheduled task service. Default value: false. If this parameter is set to false and PlannedStartTime is specified, a scheduled task is created. If this parameter is set to true, the task is executed immediately
parameters.help_zh: 是否为定时任务服务发起的执行。默认 false；false 且指定 PlannedStartTime 时创建定时任务，true 时直接执行
parameters.name: from_time_service

parameters.help_en: The target proxy performance level. Valid values: ProxyStandard, ProxyStandardx2, and ProxyStandardx4
parameters.name: proxy_target_class
